title: Cardiac perception and self-reported interoception in common mental health disorders: A systematic review and meta-analysis
title_zh: 心脏感知与自我报告的内感知在常见精神健康障碍中的关系：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: Atypical interoception may represent a transdiagnostic marker for mental health difficulties. Reviews to date exploring the relationships between interoception and mental health have presented mixed findings, with a narrow focus on cardiac measures of interoception. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies that measured the association of cardiac perception and self-reported interoception with common mental health disorders, including anxiety, depression, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and obsessive-compulsive disorder, in clinical and non-clinical samples of adults. A total of 206 effect sizes from 57 articles (total N = 6652) were eligible for inclusion in random effects meta-analyses. Overall, pooled associations showed no significant association of mental health difficulties with performance on the Heartbeat Counting Task (r = -.042), but a significant, negative association with Heart Rate Discrimination Task performance (r = -.137). Problems in adaptive interoceptive attention (r = -.183) but not sensing (r = .136), or interpretation (r = -.117), were associated with worse mental health symptomology, as was greater maladaptive interoceptive attention (r = .381). Moderator analyses showed that the size of the effect often varied between different mental health disorders, and there was some evidence of overly influential effect sizes as well as wide 95% prediction intervals. Our findings highlight the importance of methodological choices and potential differences between different performance-based tasks of cardiac interoception and different self-reported interoceptive dimensions. Our results show some support for interoception as a transdiagnostic marker for mental health difficulties that can support the development of evidence-based interventions.
abstract_zh: 异常的内感知可能是精神健康困难的跨诊断标志。迄今为止，关于内感知与精神健康关系的综述呈现出混合结果，且仅聚焦于心脏内感知测量。我们对测量心脏感知与自我报告内感知与常见精神健康障碍（包括焦虑、抑郁、精神分裂症、双相情感障碍和强迫症）之间关联的研究进行了系统综述与荟萃分析，涵盖临床与非临床成人样本。共有206个效应量来自57篇文章（总样本量N=6652）被纳入随机效应荟萃分析。总体而言，汇总效应显示心跳计数任务（Heartbeat Counting Task）与精神健康困难无显著关联（r = -.042），但心率辨别任务（Heart Rate Discrimination Task）表现与精神健康困难呈显著负相关（r = -.137）。适应性内感知注意力问题（r = -.183）与精神健康症状恶化相关，而感知（r = .136）或解释（r = -.117）则无关联；同样，过度不适应性内感知注意力（r = .381）也与症状恶化相关。调节分析显示，不同精神健康障碍之间效应大小常有差异，并且存在某些过度影响的效应量以及宽广的95%预测区间。我们的发现强调了方法学选择的重要性，以及不同基于表现的心脏内感知任务与不同自我报告内感知维度之间可能存在的差异。结果为内感知作为精神健康困难的跨诊断标志提供了一定支持，可为基于证据的干预开发提供依据。
